code='''def transform(grid):
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1

    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    color = next(value for value in counts if value not in (0, background))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
    top = min(r for r, _ in points)
    left = min(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    shape_h = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    shape_w = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(height - shape_h + 1):
        for c in range(width - shape_w + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = color
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(code)
